EXCLUSION_AMENDMENT.recorded: 2026-09-20, after D1 arm failures, before any P3 result exists
EXCLUSION_AMENDMENT.rule: documents with < 500 ingested characters are excluded from P3, for ALL arms equally
EXCLUSION_AMENDMENT.why: MS GraphRAG's extract_graph raises KeyError(['description','source_id','weight']) on a document that yields no entities -- a hard vendor failure, not a measurable 'empty graph' outcome. Keeping them stops the arm; excluding for one arm only breaks pairing.
EXCLUSION_AMENDMENT.direction_of_bias: Removes the cases where graph arms are weakest, which FLATTERS them against flat-vector and GraMM. Recorded because the exclusion is not neutral (rule 20).
